title: Samundi
desc: Samundi and his mother move into a nearby hamlet to live peacefully. However, terror strikes them once again through the local goon, who spoiled his sister's life.

title: Nenjinile
desc: Unable to find a job, Karunakaran decides to work as a henchman for a gangster. But he is forced to fight against his own gang when they hatch a plan to kill his lover Nisha and her parents.

title: Seenu
desc: Kesavan is a popular singer while his younger brother Seenu constantly gets into trouble. Things take a turn when Kesavan falls prey to alcohol addiction and loses his fame.

title: Manasukkul Mathappu
desc: A man is shattered and loses his sanity after the woman he loves dies. In the mental asylum, his doctor falls in love with him, but her father is against their union.

title: Kombu Vecha Singamda
desc: Inspired by Periyar's ideologies, six friends-turned-reformists raise their voice against social evils in their village but in doing so invite the wrath of the local rival forces.
